opening.quote: Good morning, thank you calling tide well Home, my name is sana.
opening.comment: The agent gave her name and the company name in the first turn, though the garbled transcript makes the company name hard to read.

verification.quote: Could ya give me the order number or postcode, so I can check the order?
verification.comment: The agent asked for the order number or postcode but never confirmed the caller's full name before accessing the order, so verification was incomplete.

understanding.quote: Yes, I see order 845302 for a bedding set, delivered working days later than planned.
understanding.comment: The agent captured the late delivery issue and the order details without asking for information the caller had already given.

resolution_accuracy.quote: I can add a €70 voucher to your account as goodwill for the delay.
resolution_accuracy.comment: Goodwill is capped at EUR 10 for an agent, so offering a EUR 70 voucher without team lead approval is outside policy and inaccurate.

process_compliance.quote: I'm putting you on hold now.
process_compliance.comment: The agent placed the caller on hold without asking permission first and did not thank the caller when back, and the EUR 70 voucher was promised without team lead approval.

communication.quote: I'm sorry a was late, Tom, eye understand that's frustrating when you're waiting on.
communication.comment: The agent politely acknowledged the caller's frustration over the late delivery, which meets the communication standard.

closing.comment: The agent did not confirm next steps or ask if there was anything else, and the call ended abruptly without a proper close.
